description: Defines the MimeType class for parsing and handling media content types, including parameters like codecs, width, height, and framerate.

classes.name: MimeType
classes.description: A class for parsing and representing media MIME types and their parameters.

methods.name: MimeType
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a content type string.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the MIME type was parsed successfully and is valid.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the main type component of the MIME type.

methods.name: subtype
methods.description: Returns the subtype component of the MIME type.

methods.name: GetCodecs
methods.description: Returns the list of codecs specified in the MIME type.

methods.name: GetParamCount
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters parsed.

methods.name: GetParamType
methods.description: Returns the type of a parameter at a given index.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Returns the name of a parameter at a given index.

methods.name: GetParamIndexByName
methods.description: Returns the index of a parameter by name, or kInvalidParamIndex if not found.

methods.name: GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value of a parameter at a given index.

methods.name: GetParamFloatValue
methods.description: Returns the float value of a parameter at a given index.

methods.name: GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Returns the string value of a parameter at a given index.

methods.name: GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Returns the boolean value of a parameter at a given index.

methods.name: GetParamIntValue (by name)
methods.description: Returns the integer value of a parameter by name, with default fallback.

methods.name: GetParamFloatValue (by name)
methods.description: Returns the float value of a parameter by name, with default fallback.

methods.name: GetParamStringValue (by name)
methods.description: Returns the string value of a parameter by name, with default fallback.

methods.name: GetParamBoolValue (by name)
methods.description: Returns the boolean value of a parameter by name, with default fallback.

methods.name: ValidateIntParameter
methods.description: Validates if a parameter with the given name contains a valid integer.

methods.name: ValidateFloatParameter
methods.description: Validates if a parameter with the given name contains a valid float.

methods.name: ValidateStringParameter
methods.description: Validates if a parameter with the given name matches a pattern.

methods.name: ValidateBoolParameter
methods.description: Validates if a parameter with the given name contains a valid boolean.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MIME type and its parameters.
